outcome.answer: Some ways include prompt engineering with deliberate planning and word-count tracking to keep the model within a target length without retraining [1], adding dynamic length feedback during generation so the model can adjust as it goes [2], and using reinforcement learning with a length-based reward for strict constraints [3]. Other papers suggest training-free length prediction or decoding methods, such as plug-in predictors for diffusion language models [5] and suffix-constrained greedy search for constrained outputs [6]. One paper also notes that a simple conciseness reminder can reduce excessive output length [7].
